summary: Welcome/Footer responsiveness testing - 4-style responsive system verified. All 8 viewport tests passed. Footer now uses proper 2x2 layout at mid-widths (560-979px) instead of sparse single-row, and transitions to 4-column at wider tablet/desktop (980px+).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: data-testid mismatch in Footer.tsx - getTestProps() overrides explicit data-testid attributes (e.g., footer-section-product-column becomes footer-section-product). Not blocking but could cause confusion in future tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Footer responsiveness fix verified. The 4-style responsive system is working: phone (2-column stacked), compact-tablet 560-979px (2x2 footer links), wider-tablet 980px+ (4-column single row), desktop (4-column). No horizontal overflow, careers banner centered, disclaimer contained above bottom bar. All checkpoints A-D passed.

key_findings.2x2_layout_verified: At 560-979px, footer link columns display in 2 rows (PRODUCT+RESOURCES on row 1, COMPANY+LEGAL on row 2)
key_findings.4_column_layout_verified: At 980px+, all 4 footer link columns display in single row
key_findings.no_blank_space_issue: The sparse single-row look with too much empty space at mid-widths is resolved
